title: Trace European Soil 14d6d8 native contexts
changes: Add an opt-in test-only filtered native API context capture for two unowned Soil Evidence words.
validation: Windows build 3___wn__ and Wine capture e282-soil-14d6d8-sites-wine-7mza_q21 observe all eight bytes as native byte reads in one dispatch context over 600 EUR frames.
limitations: The exported PC and outer dispatch are not exact instruction sites; source format, state equivalence, other callers/scenes and runtime ownership remain unproven.

Build m6dd0jue failed on a test-only conversion and was fixed; Wine dxkh8rfg omitted TinyCC, drained and the corrected retry passed. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance comparison was performed.
